description: This file defines the EntityListCache class, which manages a cache of lists of GenericValue objects for specific entities and conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class provides methods to retrieve, add, and remove cached entity lists, supporting optional ordering. It interacts with other OFBiz components such as EntityCondition, EntityUtil, and ModelEntity to maintain cache consistency and behavior.

classes.name: EntityListCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing lists of GenericValue objects indexed by entity name, condition, and optional ordering. It extends AbstractEntityConditionCache and provides methods to get, put, and remove cached entity lists with in-memory ordering support.

methods.name: EntityListCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GenericValue objects for the given entity and condition with optional ordering.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a list of entities in the cache for the specified entity and condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached list based on entity, condition, and ordering.

methods.name: getOrderByKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key object from the orderBy list, handling null values.
